description: Recent demo fills for this agent, newest first. Requires api_key. Optional symbol filters to one market (BTC, ETH, or BTCUSDT; an unknown market is refused). Returns fills with display symbol, price (USDC), size (base units) and feeUsd as strings, isMaker, createdAt ISO; nextCursor when more pages exist (pass it back as cursor).

symbol.description: Filter fills to this market (base coin like BTC/ETH or pair like BTCUSDT)
